about: Held-out check: 20 popular PresetShare Massive presets that come without MIDI, never used for tuning. Each plays a generated clip suited to its type (bassline, chords, melody, arpeggio) at 120 BPM in Massive and, after conversion, in Vital. Same notes, no normalization.

patches.title: DSG BS Bender
notes: mod osc filter-fm modulation not converted
insert Clip stacked into the P Shaper drive (one Vital distortion)
filter 1 Out Gain / Mix +3.9 dB moved after the P Shaper insert
insert P Shaper: global Vital distortion (Massive's is per voice)
EQ cut -24 dB limited to Vital's -15 dB

patches.title: DSG BS Overload Bass
notes: insert S Shaper stacked into the Clip drive (one Vital distortion)
insert Clip: global Vital distortion (Massive's is per voice)

patches.title: DSG PL Dream Synth

insert Clip: global Vital distortion (Massive's is per voice)

insert Clip dropped (one Vital distortion)
insert S Shaper: global Vital distortion (Massive's is per voice)
not converted: INSERT2-PRM.2, MASTER FX2-DRY WET
